projects.title: NLP-Based Hate Speech & Toxic Comment Detection
projects.shortDescription: Multi-label text classifier for automated content moderation.
projects.problem: Manual content moderation is slow and unscalable across high-volume platforms.
projects.solution: Built a multi-label text classifier (TF-IDF + Logistic Regression) achieving 91% accuracy across 6 toxicity categories on a 150K+ comment dataset (Kaggle Jigsaw). Deployed via Flask REST API with avg. response latency under 200 ms; integrated a JSON-based request/response pipeline suitable for production CMS integration.

projects.title: TripAlert Pro – Real-Time Travel Safety Platform
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack app delivering live route safety alerts and geolocation notifications.
projects.problem: Travelers lack instant access to route safety data and emergency resources.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack web app with live route safety alerts and geolocation-based notifications; stored and queried 500+ location records in MongoDB with indexed queries. Reduced alert retrieval time by 40% through MongoDB index optimisation and async JS fetch calls; deployed backend on Render and frontend on Vercel with 8 documented API endpoints.

Implemented JWT-based session management; achieved under 100 ms round-trip API latency across 50+ tested conversation flows with zero session bleed-through.
